data.narrative:
Performance Drone Works, founded by Ryan Gury, is a Series B stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $110M+ to date. The valuation landscape comprises 8 private peers including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation; no public comparables exist in this subsector.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. The Stage-Progression approach uses the $110M total capital raised as a proxy for post-money valuation at the current stage, then applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to subsequent-stage step-ups, yielding an implied valuation of $209M. A peer-median method was not feasible; while 5 same-sector peers exist, none met the narrow filtering criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier comparables (minimum 3 required), and a broad all-sector median would introduce unwarranted noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $178M (low) to $240M (high), with a midpoint of $209M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of truly comparable Series B financials in autonomous systems and the reliance on capital-raise history as a valuation proxy rather than revenue or margin data. Investors should weight this analysis accordingly and supplement with operational due diligence on unit economics and market traction.
